motion.name: welcome
motion.value: 1200ms hold; 900ms exit; wordmark scale 4 at 65% then 12 / landscape scale 1.3
motion.purpose: Supplied name-only GAZAL wordmark over generated countryside. Exit explicitly keeps overlay visible; overlay fades during final 40%. Once per session; immediate skip/Escape; reduced-motion and no-JS bypass. No video dependency.

motion.name: hero-scroll
motion.value: clamp(480px,90svh,900px) desktop / no extended compact travel (normal flow); scrub 0.22 / true
motion.purpose: Volumetric double helix: lazy Three.js Points shader, 18000 desktop / 6000 compact points, one draw, 144KB offline XYZ buffer. Two tubular strands and 29 crosslinks with depth-based shading and occlusion. Native reversible GSAP scroll, demand rendering, inactive offscreen/hidden. Matching static WebP fallback; no renderer with reduced motion.

motion.name: hero-particle-exit
motion.value: One normalized timeline; copy holds to 25%, inert at 49%; framing opens 49-69% after the copy is hidden; release 70% desktop / 48% compact and continues under Soluciones
motion.purpose: Scroll rotates the particle cloud a full 360 degrees about its longitudinal axis from 2.5% to 70% desktop / 48% compact, then gathers and releases it. This replaces the earlier shallow yaw/roll of a flat image. The local pointer response uses twelve samples with 850ms decay, resumes 180ms after scroll settles until all particles exit, and acts on projected positions. No touch interception or extra render loop. The volumetric axial revolution is combined with progressive lateral inclination (0.38 radians desktop / 0.24 compact), applied after projection and before release and pointer input. Both reverse with scroll.

motion.name: dropdown
motion.value: 90ms hover open / 180ms hover close; 180ms panel arrival; 160ms language arrival
motion.purpose: Full-width desktop disclosure panels. Click toggles; ArrowDown opens and focuses the first link; Escape closes with focus return. Outside/blur dismissal does not lock or reposition scroll. Focus within preserves the panel during pointer exit. Reduced motion removes CSS arrival and trigger transitions.

motion.name: drilldown

motion.name: transformation
motion.value: 720ms desktop / 500ms compact particle movement; 130ms desktop stagger; 4.5-second stage intervals
motion.purpose: Official 1dcd984 particle diagram restored with current editorial copy. 120 SVG particles across four conceptual stages; compact animates every third particle. Stage buttons, pause/replay and repeat; no range input. One visible pass, manual control takes precedence; immediate keyboard/reduced-motion positioning.

narrative.overview: Pale mint and sage fields, forest ink, generous editorial typography and fine rules connect industrial material to applied science. The supplied GAZAL raster lockup preserves its exact serif lettering and symbol. Open sections retain the current editorial architecture. A brief rural welcome leads into the restored official ADN-only particle ribbon, followed by static kit gradients and the original process particle diagrams. The homepage HIDROBAC explorer keeps its original layered figure and controls below it; the internal page restores the official six-stage SVG lab. Generated scenery and conceptual diagrams are distinct from operational evidence. Light green remains primary, with only restrained incumbent brass details outside the gradient kit.
keyCharacteristics: Light green fields with forest text and focused dark sections.
Exact supplied GAZAL lettering and static gradients from the brand kit.
A rural welcome followed by an immersive particle ribbon driven by native scroll.
Large Manrope headlines paired with readable Lexend supporting text.
Square controls, fine rules and open editorial rows.
Material concepts visibly distinguished from operational evidence.
Keyboard access and reduced motion built into interactions.

rules.name: The Light Green Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep the supplied GAZAL lockup intact and use the established mint, sage and forest family. Keep the gradient kit within its five supplied colors; retain brass only as a restrained incumbent detail outside that kit.

rules.name: The Exact Lettering Rule
rules.body: Display the supplied GAZAL lettering as the transparent raster lockup. The kit contains no installable logo font; never substitute a serif approximation or make the interface inherit the logo lettering. The header and footer use `public/assets/gazal/gazal-horizontal-transparente.webp`.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate content through field color, spacing and hairlines before adding elevation effects.

rules.name: The Concept Label Rule
rules.body: Keep conceptual artwork and diagrams visibly labeled; do not present them as plant photography, measured process evidence or product proof.

dos: **Do** preserve the supplied GAZAL symbol and exact raster lettering unchanged.
**Do** build with the existing green tokens, local fonts and open editorial hierarchy.
**Do** retain visible keyboard focus, semantic labels and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** keep conceptual image captions visible and critical form guidance legible.
**Do** inspect stylesheet overrides before extending a responsive component.
**Do** keep the particle scroll native, its local type overrides scoped and its static image fallback complete.
**Do** use the supplied gradients as static surfaces within their five-color kit.
donts: **Don't** let gold dominate or substitute a generic SaaS identity.
**Don't** add rounded shadow cards as the default content structure.
**Don't** treat material concepts as evidence of facilities, certifications or results.
**Don't** make information or controls depend on animation or hover.
**Don't** imply that an enquiry was sent when it was only prepared locally.
**Don't** replace the GAZAL lettering with an approximate font or present generated forest imagery as company photography.
